per_pair_additional_field.adjudication_grounds: Concrete actual relevant source evidence and agreement/disagreement assessment; not category vote counts. Address each reader difference and why the specific common evidence supports a repeat/difference or remains uncertain.

release_rules: Full repeat requires all three actual reports to support complete construction/all8 owned FULL compatibility, with no unresolved significant variation.

Observed difference requires common specifically identified (feature,difference_kind) with positively supported owned FULL relevant evidence in both fresh readers and final. STRUCTURAL_FEATURE_DIFFERENCE and VISIBLE_FORM_VARIATION both keep cipher/allographic significance UNKNOWN; unrelated uncertainty need not erase a visible local fact.
Preserve every reader local difference, uncertainty and raw fact reference even if aggregate UNCERTAIN. A single unsupported local report does not become a released difference.
No observation or UNCERTAIN verdict for the unchecked708; no graph/sequence update, transitive inference, letters or cipher cannot-links.
Validate exact frozen input/report references; no fabricated source report or arbitrary caller-supplied final hash can authorize production output.
serialization: Immutable UTF-8 JSON; final source review conditioned on both frozen initials, with independently checked actual native paired panels before views. Source locators are approximate, not route masks or mechanical target-binding proofs.
